def round_half_up(x):
    return int(floor(x+0.5))

    pid=p['playlist_id']

    results.append({'playlist_id':pid,'title':detail['title'],'song_count':len(detail['songs']),'total_seconds':total_seconds,'minutes':minutes,'rounded':rounded})

shortest=None
